product.title: Small-Group Grampians Great Wilderness Escape Day Trip with Hiking

description.text: In Melbourne, this small-group wilderness day leaves a central meeting point for Halls Gap, Boroka Lookout, MacKenzie Falls, The Balconies, and Brambuk The National Park & Cultural Centre. The public page notes Silverband Falls if MacKenzie Falls is closed rather than inventing a substitute circuit. The format suits visitors who want guided Grampians hiking without a Great Ocean Road limestone-stack day. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those lookouts and cultural-centre stops that define this outing rather than a Hosier Lane studio walk.

start.description: Meet at a confirmed central Melbourne meeting point listed when booking. Start time is 7:35am.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
